name: Statusline
description: Statusline renderers for the Claude Code harness. Silent by default (zero bytes to stdout). Their sole purpose is writing session metrics (session_tokens, context_pct, five_hour_pct) to ~/.ghola/statusline/state/<key>.json, which feeds the VS Code status-bar pill. Do NOT remove statusLine from ~/.claude/settings.json — the harness would stop invoking the renderer and the pill would go blank. GHOLA_STATUSLINE_SILENT=0 un-silences for [Ghola vX.Y.Z] version-only output. The .sh uses python3 with a node fallback writer; neither available = silent blank pill. Settings below are INERT.

showVersion.label: Show Version
showVersion.description: Inert — not read by either renderer (they're standalone scripts; VS Code's globalState isn't visible to them). The statusline is silent by default; GHOLA_STATUSLINE_SILENT=0 shows only [Ghola vX.Y.Z].

showCumulativeTokens.label: Show Context Token Count (RETIRED)
showCumulativeTokens.description: Retired and inert — the token-count segment was removed from both renderers; toggling this does nothing. The value is still written to disk as session_tokens and shown (abbreviated) in the VS Code status-bar pill.

showContextPercent.label: Show Context Percent
showContextPercent.description: Inert — the context-percent segment no longer exists in either renderer. The value is still written to disk as context_pct and shown in the VS Code status-bar pill.

showRollingWindowPercent.label: Show Rolling Window Percent
showRollingWindowPercent.description: Inert — the 5-hour segment no longer exists in either renderer. The value is still written to disk as five_hour_pct (when rate limits are available) and shown in the VS Code status-bar pill.

redThresholdPercent.label: Red Threshold Percent
redThresholdPercent.description: Inert — no threshold or color remains; both percentage segments and the red tint were removed from both renderers. Restoring this needs a code change, not a settings change.

fallbackToVersionOnly.label: Fallback To Version Only
fallbackToVersionOnly.description: Inert — moot either way: every payload (good, missing, or malformed) yields the same silent output by default, or the same [Ghola vX.Y.Z] with GHOLA_STATUSLINE_SILENT=0.
